import re, sys
try:
    txt = open("settings.yaml", encoding="utf-8").read()
except OSError:
    sys.exit(1)
ok = any(re.fullmatch(r"debug\s*:\s*(false|False|FALSE)\s*(#.*)?", l.rstrip()) for l in txt.splitlines())
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
